findings.note: faro-url.ts:20 toPathTemplate and faro-privacy.ts:41 scrubString: only numeric/UUID segments are templated, and span URL paths are never touched. DELETE teams/{teamId}/members/{email} (team.repository.impl.ts:56) puts the member email in the path. It reaches Faro in api_request_failed.path_template and in OTLP span http.url / http.target. Breaks the ticket rule 'no email in Faro events' and design.md:110 ('Paths use UUIDs, not names or emails') is wrong. Fix: also template segments with '@' or '%40' (and decide on other non-id segments), and apply the same segment redaction to URL-valued keys (url, url.full, http.url, http.target, name) in the beforeSend scrub. Re-check M4 for this call.
